run_run_loop: run the simulation loop with an initial state, step function, and optional logging and progress bar
run_run_loop_with_max_steps: run the simulation loop with a maximum step count limit that stops early if reached
run_run_loop_with_logging: run the simulation loop with timestep info logging enabled for every step
run_run_loop_check_errors: run the simulation loop and check for solver convergence errors during execution
run_run_loop_measure_timing: run the simulation loop and measure wall clock time per step with first-step tracing detection
